summary: The Decathalon datalist loader is implemented but not executed. Changes: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new loader load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path, standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection nested under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with four tests: test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Tests were not run, and black/flake8 were not run; line lengths were measured with awk and none exceed 120, but black may reformat some multi-line raise calls. Nothing is committed. Choices made: no type hints; absent image/label fields are left absent rather than rejected; a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; invalid JSON propagates as json.JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass).
